description: Include memory seeder in Docker container build for deployed environments

userStories.title: Remove seeds from .dockerignore and preserve in Dockerfile
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the seeds directory included in the Docker build with source files preserved.
acceptanceCriteria: Update backend/Dockerfile find-delete command to also exclude seeds: ! -path /app/seeds/*
Verify seeds/ files are present in built image
Existing functionality unaffected (app starts, migrations work)
userStories.notes: Two changes: 1) .dockerignore line removal, 2) Dockerfile find command update
